en: The image is a vintage illustrated postcard depicting a bearded man in profile, wearing a monocle and formal attire. The style is a colored drawing or caricature, with text at the top and bottom of the postcard. The top reads 'CELEBRIDADES PORTUGUEZAS,' indicating it is part of a series on Portuguese celebrities. The name 'COLUMBANO' appears at the bottom, likely referring to the Portuguese painter Columbano Bordalo Pinheiro. There is also a publisher's mark and some small printed text.
